p: one year: While these things were done.
two years over Israel: Before he took upon himself the state of a king.
Geba: Of Kirjath-jearim, where the ark was, 1Sa 10:5.
trumpet throughout all the land: That everyone should prepare themselves to fight.
Bethaven: Which was also called Beth-el, in the tribe of Benjamin.
Gad and Gilead: Where the two tribes and the half remained.
scattered from him: Thinking that the absence of the prophet was a sign, that they would lose the victory.
scattered from me: Though these causes seem sufficient in man's judgment: yet because they had not the word of God, they turned to his destruction.
God: Who willed you to obey him, and rest on the words spoken by his prophet.
man after his own heart: That is, David.
Gibeah of Benjamin: And went to his city Ramah.
another company turned to the way: So that to man's judgment these three armies would have overrun the whole country.
sword nor spear found in the: To declare that the victory only came from God, and not by their force.
